digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and pack-size management
propositions: The filtered tickets pack has exceeded the Gerrit CI verification gate limit (131431 KiB observed vs 131072 KiB limit), causing all in-flight changes to receive Verified -1 and blocking landings regardless of code correctness.

Spent ~1 GiB of unreachable .bridge_state history is scattered across the repository and cannot be reclaimed by repack/gc alone; history rewriting via git fast-export filtering is required to strip it.

A coordinated quiet-window operation must execute ticket 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a (diagnostic repair to zero-diagnostic state) before history rewrite to ensure the authoritative store is clean before repacking.

Pre-rewrite and post-rewrite off-repo bundles must be created, verified, and compared to establish rollback checkpoints and validate that tree content, commit count, merge-commit count, and identity-report multisets remain invariant across the rewrite.

Publication of the rewritten history must use exact force-with-lease semantics with verified old-tip/new-tip values, and must pass assertions that old-tip has no reachable ancestors, no refs fetch it by default clone, and incremental pack growth remains under 1 MB.
